scope: Current working-tree iOS implementation, including SwiftUI, UIKit, NotesWeb, launch artwork runtime, Cubism, notifications, widgets, and the actual API contracts it calls.
status: Approved source implementation and integrated simulator regression complete; 17 hardware/fault/performance checks retain explicit acceptance limits.

items.finding: Conversation disk cache is shared by every account, server and workspace. loadConversation displays latest.json before ensuring the current inbox; logout clears only memory. If the new inbox request fails, another account's private messages remain visible.
items.change: Scope cached messages by server, user, workspace and conversation; reject mismatched cache envelopes before presentation, and clear account-owned transient outputs at session boundaries.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Small secondary text uses #868A91 on #F7F8FA or white: calculated contrast is 3.26:1 or 3.47:1. User messages force white text on the adaptive accent; its dark-mode #8AB2FF gives only 2.12:1. Important instructions and sent messages lose readability.
items.change: Use semantic foreground/background pairs, including accentLabel for accent fills; strengthen small-text contrast and verify all normal, error, selected and disabled combinations in both appearances.
items.evidenceBasis: Source foreground/background pairs and a read-only WCAG luminance calculation. Full device accessibility review remains pending.

items.finding: Dynamic Type covers selected headings/body views but leaves auth fields, feature text, question stems/editors, full replies, annotation answers, segmented labels and WK titles/code/tables at fixed sizes. Large-type fixtures therefore do not mean the whole experience scales.
items.change: Use semantic styles or scaled metrics throughout; send scale to Web content, allow layout reflow, and switch dense two-column layouts when necessary. Preserve the app's rounded visual identity.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and visual comparison of normal, loading, and supported large-type Debug fixtures.

items.finding: Core actions have small touch targets: note/diary-reference removal is 15x15 pt, rewrite removal 30x30, the Web selection toolbar about 29 pt high, annotation locate 28 pt, annotation actions 34 pt, version restore 30 pt, and several conversation controls 38 pt high. Outer row padding does not enlarge the inner button.
items.change: Provide comfortable hit regions around the existing compact visuals; check neighbouring targets and VoiceOver activation without inflating every visual control.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Floating/history playback pause-resume uses only an accessibility-hidden glyph and has no accessible name. The memory correction TextEditor also has no explicit accessible label. Their parent screens otherwise provide meaningful labels.
items.change: Give each control its actual current action/value and associate editable fields with their labels; verify the resulting VoiceOver tree and focus order.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Generic .list/.cards skeletons are reused for persona/convention forms, memory cards, version timelines, overview, mind map and operation questions. .cards currently draws the same icon-and-lines fallback as a list, so placeholders do not reserve the loaded content's structure.
items.change: Create content-shaped placeholders per page family; keep headings/actions stable and preserve existing content during refresh. Avoid adding decorative loading motion.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and visual comparison of normal, loading, and supported large-type Debug fixtures.

items.finding: Copy feedback starts an independent timer for every tap. A previous note-copy timer or invite-copy timer can dismiss the newest confirmation almost immediately; invite feedback can also carry across receipt changes.
items.change: Own feedback with a cancellable task and an operation/receipt identity; a new copy restarts only its own reading interval.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: The current-workspace row remains an accessible Button even though hit testing is disabled and its action deliberately returns. It does not expose selected-state semantics, so assistive navigation encounters a misleading inert action.
items.change: Represent the current room as selected information or a meaningful control, with an explicit selected value and no dead activation path.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: About advertises updates for reading and launch-motion resources. The client calls /app/client-assets/manifest, for which the current API has no implementation, and LaunchMotionWebView always loads the bundle rather than the updater's active root. The advertised startup-resource update has no complete call chain.
items.change: Implement and verify the resource manifest/activation flow and connect both consumers, or present the capability honestly as unavailable until that chain exists. Keep offline bundle fallback explicit.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: On first inbox identification, loadConversation clears cached messages. refreshMessages absorbs its GET failure, after which loadConversation writes the empty array to disk. A recoverable history outage therefore destroys the available offline copy.
items.change: Keep a correctly scoped cache until a successful replacement receipt; propagate refresh outcome and never persist a failed/partial fetch as a successful empty history.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Message-cache serialization drops selection/inputReference and rich-block routes, source references, titles, diagrams, citations and file metadata. It is written during loadConversation rather than on later message receipts. Offline history loses both recent messages and the evidence needed to understand old ones.
items.change: Cache the complete supported message contract in a versioned, scoped envelope and update it from successful message receipts, with bounded retention.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: The text field remains editable during recording/transcription, but manual and 59-second automatic ASR completion unconditionally replace store.draft. A late transcription can erase a correction or unrelated text the user just typed.
items.change: Track the draft revision owned by each recording; merge or offer the transcript when text has changed instead of overwriting newer work.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Typing or attaching material during recording makes voiceAction false while canSend is false. The same button still represents Finish recording but becomes disabled. Only Cancel or the undisclosed automatic timeout remains.
items.change: Make recording completion an independent enabled action while recording; define text/attachment coexistence explicitly and preserve the user's latest intent.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: VoiceCapture deletes the only WAV in defer on success, empty transcription and network failure. A temporary transcription failure after a long answer cannot be retried from the recording.
items.change: Retain a failed recording as a recoverable draft with retry and explicit discard; clean it only after success, cancellation or the chosen retention policy.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Transcription has no visible cancellation control, although its request can wait 90 seconds and sending stays disabled. The user can type during the wait but cannot abandon ASR and send that text.
items.change: Expose Cancel transcription, cancel/fence the pending operation and restore ordinary sending immediately; pair this with draft-revision protection.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: The reference picker lists only store.notes and requests the newest 30. It has no search or pagination, so older notes cannot be selected through this feature.
items.change: Give the picker its own searchable/paginated data scope and preserve the chosen note/version identity.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Reference-picker loading, empty and failure cases are the same blank list. Reader lookup has no row busy state, and its errors are assigned behind the sheet. A slow or failed selection looks inert.
items.change: Render initial loading, no notes, no matches, per-row progress and retry in the picker itself; retain the list during refresh.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Each note-picker tap starts an unfenced task. If A returns after a later B selection, A overwrites B's pending reference after the sheet closes. Completion also lacks token/workspace ownership checks.
items.change: Use a latest-selection identity and session scope; ignore stale receipts and show which row is being resolved.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Tapping a historical diary reference creates an input reader with no body text. That reader only displays supplied text and its destination controls support files/notes, leaving a diary reference with metadata but no content or destination.
items.change: Resolve the exact referenced diary/version, or clearly explain its availability and offer the appropriate diary destination with loading/error states.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: The current worker emits recommendation cards and learning_artifact routes, but iOS drops recommendation metadata and accepts only note routes. Non-note recommendations disappear; note recommendations lose their title/reason and become generic result cards.
items.change: Decode and render the active recommendation contract, including exact artifact destinations; provide a visible fallback for unsupported content instead of silent omission.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Follow-up suggestions supplied by the service have no DTO/view representation, and assistant.followups.ready is ignored. The server-provided continuation actions are unavailable on iOS.
items.change: Decide the intended iOS presentation, then carry the supported prompt contract through persistence, replay and accessible actions; avoid silently discarding it.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Saved-version result previews replace every image with a suggestion to open the current note. After the note changes, this cannot establish what the historical result contained.
items.change: Render authenticated images belonging to the saved version, with loading, failure, retry and full-size inspection.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: View this full record only changes journal state. From a saved result in mini chat on Library it dismisses back to mini chat, without selecting Conversation or locating the full record. This was reproduced in the running app.
items.change: Use one scope-aware navigation command that dismisses the relevant sheet, selects the records surface and locates the requested run after presentation.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and simulator interaction: saved result → View full record from Library mini chat returned to the same mini chat.

items.finding: Older-history pagination loads run details only from message.runId. User messages have null runId, so failed/stopped turns without an assistant row and outside the newest-20 run snapshot lose their failure/process/recovery controls.
items.change: Page or resolve run ownership by user-message identity as well as assistant run IDs; retain actionable terminal runs in older history.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Record projection excludes terminal runs without a visible user or assistant message. Proactive runs can have no user message, so a silent completed run with saved results is filtered out even when loaded explicitly. The projection defect is proven; its production frequency is unmeasured.
items.change: Keep terminal runs that own results or actionable receipts visible and locatable, without fabricating a spoken message.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Initial sync fetches messages, then a run snapshot, then starts replay after that snapshot's latestSeq. A reply committed between the two reads can be absent from messages but already excluded from replay, leaving it missing until another refresh.
items.change: Establish a consistent snapshot/replay boundary and reconcile messages after the cursor boundary, with a test that commits a reply between the two responses.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: When the run snapshot fails, initial sync substitutes cursor zero. Replay can treat historical speech as live, or repeatedly hit CURSOR_EXPIRED and repeat the same failed recovery path. Snapshot failure is being converted into a valid cursor.
items.change: Keep sync in an explicit recoverable state until a trustworthy cursor is obtained; separate historical replay from live delivery and bound resynchronization retries.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Chat Live Activity updates only when isSending changes. Submission acceptance can mark the previous assistant message as Already replied, while the new utterance never updates it. Ordinary completion and logout do not end the chat activity, so stale content can remain on the lock screen.
items.change: Bind activities to account/conversation/run identity, update from real delivery status and clear them at completion and session boundaries.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Notification payloads contain conversationId/messageId but opening ignores both and operates on the current inbox. A stale notification surviving a scope boundary has no validation or correct-room routing. Foreground cleanup lowers occurrence but does not make this handler scope-aware.
items.change: Validate notification ownership, restore or explicitly explain the referenced scope, then locate the exact message/run; never silently interpret another scope's identifier in the current room.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: File, camera, microphone and authorization failures share one generic error channel. Retry reloads Conversation, or sends the draft if an old turnSubmitFailed flag remains; it does not retry the failed action.
items.change: Use typed failures with an operation-specific recovery action and preserved input. A file/mic retry must not implicitly send text.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Conversation retry/reconnect owns no loading state; history uses global isLoading, also used by note fetching. Empty history can show no conversations during a real request, or show a skeleton for unrelated note work; repeated Retry stays enabled.
items.change: Separate conversation initial-load, refresh and reconnect states from note/account work, and keep retry feedback on the operation being retried.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: The composer accepts arbitrarily long text and starts attachment uploads before the server rejects text beyond its hard limit. The resulting technical English error is passed to the user without an editing target.
items.change: Match the server's text-length unit before uploading; show a precise editable validation state while preserving the entire draft and attachment receipts.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Model idle, downloading and failure all display the same PNG. Download/render failure has no explanation or in-app Retry, and ordinary reconnection does not recover it. The companion can stay static for the rest of the session.
items.change: Keep a quiet fallback while exposing real download/failure status and targeted recovery in an appropriate place; retry without requiring sign-out or relaunch.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Required texture load/decode/allocation failures return null and are logged/ignored; bridge success checks only whether the model object exists. Missing Metal availability also returns without a failure transition. Some blank/partial renders therefore never activate PNG fallback.
items.change: Propagate required rendering-resource failures to the shared renderer state and provide a recoverable fallback, distinguishing temporary drawable readiness from terminal failure.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: A cached model is accepted by file count/path/byte size without comparing content hashes. Same-size corruption or corrected bytes in the same version can keep reusing a bad model, compounding the missing recovery UI.
items.change: Compare manifest identity/hashes and invalidate/revalidate failed versions on recovery. Avoid introducing unconditional expensive hashing on every UI update.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: The WK reader loads a local file and inserts image src values directly. First-party uploads use authenticated /api/uploads URLs, but there is no API-origin or authenticated image bridge. Relative uploads resolve against file:, and image failure has no placeholder/retry path.
items.change: Resolve first-party media through an authenticated, version-aware native/Web bridge and implement loading, error, retry and inspection states.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Reader note links never reach requestNoteReference; the WK coordinator has no link policy or note-link message handler. The in-app note link was visibly inert in the simulator. HTTP links can replace the reader document without an application browser-return path.
items.change: Route internal links to the exact application destination and external links to an appropriate browser surface; keep the reader document and its position intact.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and simulator interaction: tapped a visible in-note blue note link with no navigation or response.

items.finding: Selections derive offsets/excerpts from DOM textContent after KaTeX. A read-only reproduction turns '方程 $x^2=1$ 的解。' into '方程 x2=1x^2=1x2=1 的解。', while server anchors use canonical TeX-source text. Valid formula paragraphs cannot yield matching anchors/highlights.
items.change: Use one canonical text/offset projection with a mapping to rendered DOM ranges, covering formulas, inline syntax and line breaks; verify end-to-end anchor acceptance.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and read-only jsdom/KaTeX rendering probe against the bundled reader, compared with the shared canonical projection.

items.finding: The reader bypasses the shared note grammar. A valid list block becomes a paragraph, ==highlight==/subscript/superscript remain literal, and soft-newline text differs from the canonical coordinate projection. Supported rich structures do not have equivalent reading/anchor behaviour.
items.change: Reuse or faithfully implement the canonical note projection and extensions, with parity examples covering all supported block and inline types.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and read-only jsdom/KaTeX rendering probe against the bundled reader, compared with the shared canonical projection.

items.finding: Restore this version is offered to real mobile sessions, but the endpoint requires owner and rejects clientKind mobile even for owners. The dialog also promises a newly saved version, whereas the service changes the current-version pointer. The UI promises an operation that cannot succeed and describes different effects.
items.change: Align the intended confirmed restore operation, mobile/owner authorization and actual version semantics; expose an honest read-only state where it is unavailable and preserve conflict recovery.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Members can enter import and prepare a document, and the client explicitly says members may import. POST /import/markdown is owner-only, so Save as note predictably fails after the preparation work.
items.change: Resolve the member-import capability in the actual server contract and gate or support the action consistently before file preparation.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Library import preparation and failure write attachmentPreparationProgress/errorMessage, which neither Library nor the shell presents. Large/locked/scanned/corrupt documents and offline import can fail with no visible explanation or recovery on the initiating page.
items.change: Give library import its own preparation, cancellation, validation, failure and retry presentation; preserve the selected material and avoid routing the error behind a conversation surface.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: WK file-load/navigation failure and Web content-process termination have no delegate-to-error transition. Slow-note recovery stops when a document exists, so the reader can remain loading/blank even though its data request succeeded.
items.change: Handle all WK failure/termination paths and rebuild the reader from the preserved document/position with a visible retry state.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Search updates notesQuery before requesting, but retains old notes on failure. The list then labels A's retained items as B's search results. A generic error below the cards does not identify that the results belong to a different query.
items.change: Keep result identity with the query that produced it; show retained results as stale/previous results or keep the new result region in a clear failed state.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: After successful annotation deletion, the drawer falls back to initialAnnotation when the item disappears from the store. Deleted text and edit/delete actions remain visible and repeating them returns 404.
items.change: Represent deletion explicitly, dismiss or transition the drawer after the receipt, and never revive an initial snapshot as the live record.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Both annotation drawers discard the ordinal passed by Return to original and only close the sheet. Offscreen source passages are never located.
items.change: Route the source ordinal through the existing version-aware jump function after dismissal and support unloaded source pages.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Annotations are fetched without version or pagination, limited to 100 across all versions, then filtered to the current version. An older-version collection can consume the page and make valid current highlights disappear without a partial-result indication.
items.change: Request the intended version and paginate to a complete or explicitly bounded result; keep older-version history separate and visible when requested.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Version history requests limit=50, offset=0 and has no next-page action or partial indicator. Earlier valid history becomes inaccessible.
items.change: Add version-history pagination and accurate total/partial state while retaining the current selection and scroll position.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Opening/reloading a note immediately clears its visible annotations. A failed annotation request is reported only inside an annotation drawer; the main reader silently loses the highlights.
items.change: Preserve correctly scoped highlights during refresh and show annotation-specific availability/retry without replacing readable body content.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: An AI explanation holds one global isAnnotationBusy flag. A user trying to annotate an unrelated range encounters a disabled editor/save even though only the original working range should be locked.
items.change: Own busy state per operation/range and distinguish editable drafts from in-flight writes; preserve the existing precise range lock.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Version dates use only default ISO8601DateFormatter, while API dates contain fractional seconds. A local Foundation probe accepts the fixture timestamp without fractions and rejects the real-format example, producing missing dates.
items.change: Use the project's tolerant ISO8601 parsing path consistently and test actual serialized API timestamps.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and a read-only Foundation ISO8601 parsing probe; fractional and non-fractional timestamps compared.

items.finding: Each unloaded outline jump starts a task, while loadNotePage rejects any request during another page load. A later B destination can be dropped and an earlier A request can scroll after B was selected.
items.change: Own a latest destination request, cancel or supersede earlier work and apply only the newest requested jump after its page becomes available.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: The WK payload key omits appearance/resolved colors and title. A retained reader can skip an appearance-only or title-only update, leaving native chrome and Web content inconsistent until another key changes. Visual reproduction of each reachable appearance path is still required.
items.change: Include all rendered metadata/theme inputs in invalidation and update those properties without resetting reading position.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Mind-map x positions clamp every depth >=2 to the same third column. A legal single-child depth-2/depth-3 chain also shares centerY, so one node completely obscures another.
items.change: Lay out the actual supported tree depth, derive canvas bounds from node geometry and preserve readable separation for every legal node.
items.evidenceBasis: Source geometry/coordinate derivation. Physical pan/pinch feel and large-graph profiling remain pending.

items.finding: Fit to screen resets zoom/pan but computes fit from width alone. Minimum leaf spacing can place nodes beyond the reported targetHeight, so large graphs remain outside the viewport after Fit.
items.change: Compute complete graph bounds, fit both dimensions and center those bounds while allowing later direct manipulation.
items.evidenceBasis: Source geometry/coordinate derivation. Physical pan/pinch feel and large-graph profiling remain pending.

items.finding: Live pinch clamps zoom*fit*pinchScale, but pinch completion clamps zoom*value before applying fit. On a typical phone fit about 0.766, a live 2.4 scale can snap back to about 1.84 on release. Geometry mismatch is proven; physical pinch remains unverified.
items.change: Use one scale coordinate system and clamp policy for live interaction, release and zoom buttons; preserve the presented scale at handoff.
items.evidenceBasis: Source geometry/coordinate derivation. Physical pan/pinch feel and large-graph profiling remain pending.

items.finding: Mind-map parsing drops source ordinals, retained quotes are never shown, and node text is capped at two lines without a detail action. Zoom cannot reveal the omitted explanation or navigate to evidence.
items.change: Offer readable node detail and exact source navigation, retaining note/version/block identity; let the canvas remain a summary rather than the only reader.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: An expansion draft's body is limited to six preview lines; tapping the card only selects it. Users must accept substantial AI content without a way to read the full draft, although the service supports reviewed edits.
items.change: Add full draft review and, where appropriate, title/body editing before acceptance while preserving selection state.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Accepting any subset of expansion drafts sets local task.status to confirmed. The server remains ready until all drafts are confirmed, so the unselected drafts disappear until the feature is reopened.
items.change: Apply the server receipt's remaining-draft/task state and keep unaccepted drafts available for review or explicit dismissal.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Expansion selection stays editable during review/confirmation. An earlier review receipt replaces drafts after a newer tap, and selectedDraftIDs is then read from that overwritten state. The committed subset can differ from the latest visible choice.
items.change: Freeze or revision-track the submitted selection and reconcile receipts without discarding newer edits; show the exact batch being accepted.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Overview, mind map and expansion replace existing results whenever the latest generation ticket is not ready. A failed regeneration can keep the older readable result hidden even after reopening, with no View existing result action.
items.change: Keep the last successful result readable while showing the new task's status and failure separately; make result version and generation identity explicit.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Reopened learning-card failures pass human-readable generationFailure through an enum-only formatter, collapsing useful causes to a generic message. Mind-map failureMessage is also discarded. Recovery instructions disappear across task restoration.
items.change: Persist/display structured failure codes together with safe human explanations and the correct recoverable action.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: A generation-time consent rejection can become literal ai_consent_required in a progress page with only Retry. The authorization-aware dock is hidden during generation, so the user cannot recover from that state in context.
items.change: Represent authorization/data-policy failures as typed states with an accessible settings destination and a preserved original request.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Materials and processing status unconditionally claims Only local and Connected, and reports store.notes.count as the room total. Imports/read data use the server, and notes is only a loaded/search subset. Offline/search/paginated cases produce false status statements.
items.change: Derive locality, connection and counts from actual state/receipts and label partial or unknown values honestly.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Native text selection/edit actions are disabled and replacement selection requires a touch/pointer hold. There is no equivalent keyboard/assistive action to create a passage selection; focusable annotation marks also have no Enter/Space handler.
items.change: Provide equivalent accessible selection and passage actions, preserve appropriate native capabilities, and verify keyboard/VoiceOver operation rather than relying on visual touch controls alone.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Overview/map/expansion initialize loading=false and await account settings before starting their content read. Their first render can claim Nothing generated before existing results were requested, creating a false empty intermediate state.
items.change: Start in unknown/loading, request independent data concurrently when safe, and distinguish first load from refresh without flashing an empty primer.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Answer editors remain interactive while submission flushes answers and awaits Complete. A late edit can enter the buffer after grading starts; the server rejects further saves, while Close refuses to leave with a nonempty buffer. Normal exit can become blocked by an unsaveable edit.
items.change: Establish a submission ownership boundary: finish/freeze the submitted revision atomically, preserve any later draft separately and always provide a recoverable exit without silently losing work.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Learning-card versionNumber reads nonexistent card.versionNo, then falls back to the current note version. The API supplies noteVersionId and a separate versions list. Older questions and stars can consequently be labelled as the new note version with no stale warning.
items.change: Resolve the card's immutable source version through the actual contract; present old-version cards/results honestly and make switching/regeneration explicit.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Regenerate lets the user choose 4/6/8 questions, but an existing same-version card returns card_exists with no generation job. iOS simply reloads the unchanged card, silently ignoring the selected count.
items.change: Align the regenerate action with server semantics: either support a deliberate replacement flow or honestly explain/reuse the existing card without pretending to regenerate it.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: The complete-practice count is calculated from at most 50 returned attempts rather than the accurate completedAttemptCount already supplied by the card. Long-term totals are understated.
items.change: Use the server's complete statistic and keep paged attempt history separate from aggregate progress.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Repair-steps questions store selection order in an invisible array but show only pressed buttons in the original reversed list. Different complete orderings look identical in read-only replay, hiding the defining answer property.
items.change: Show the chosen sequence/positions as it is constructed and replay that exact order in the completed read-only result.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Operation questions hardcode a light cream/green theme and fixed text sizes. The host supplies answers/readOnly but no appearance, scale or motion preferences, making operation questions inconsistent with dark mode and accessibility settings.
items.change: Pass semantic appearance/typography/motion inputs through the artifact host contract while keeping read-only controls genuinely noneditable.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Saving a typo/dead service address logs the user out, but logged-out authentication and recovery screens contain no service-address editor. The connection cannot be repaired through ordinary app navigation.
items.change: Provide service recovery from login/session failure and validate the chosen origin without trapping access to the editor; preserve the current endpoint until the change is explicitly committed.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: Workspace rows guard isSpaceBusy, but switchWorkspace sets only isAccountBusy and permits concurrent switches. The first response rotates the token and causes a later intended selection to be discarded. The UI follows response order rather than the latest tap.
items.change: Own switching as a distinct operation with target identity, a defined latest-intent policy and coherent progress/disabled states.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: A normal switch with stayOnCurrentTab clears profile, removes MainTabShell and loses its local management navigation path. Switch/create/current-room leave or dissolve returns to Me root rather than the promised management list. Debug switching bypasses the boundary reset and conceals this difference.
items.change: Preserve an explicit safe post-switch destination across session restoration and present the resulting notice/draft warning at that destination.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.

items.finding: The Disputed memory filter returns false unconditionally and the list model does not retain epistemicStatus. A disputed memory can never appear in its dedicated filter.
items.change: Carry actual memory state into the list and implement the server-aligned disputed filter with truthful empty-state copy.
items.evidenceBasis: Source and call-chain inspection; no live backend mutation reproduced.
